title: Zigzag Grid Traversal With Skip
summary: Given an m x n 2D array of positive integers, traverse it in a zigzag pattern, skipping every alternate cell.
statement: Given an m x n 2D array of positive integers, traverse it in a zigzag pattern, skipping every alternate cell. Start at (0,0), move right to the end of the row, then drop down and move left to the start of the row, continuing to alternate directions until all rows are traversed. Skip every second cell during the traversal and return the values of the visited cells in the order they are visited.
constraints: Traverse row zero left to right, row one right to left, and continue alternating directions.
Across that single traversal, visit the first cell and skip every alternate cell.
Return visited values in traversal order without modifying grid.
hints: Form the row traversal in alternating directions.
Maintain one take/skip flag across row boundaries.
Append a value only when the flag says take, then flip it after every cell.
A persistent flag implements alternate-cell skipping over the complete zigzag sequence.
editorial: A persistent flag implements alternate-cell skipping over the complete zigzag sequence.

tests.explanation: The zigzag order is 1,2,4,3; taking alternate cells gives [1,4].
The zigzag order yields alternate visited values [1,3,5,7,9].
